blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Persuasive writing exploits cognitive biases, recruiting a reader's mental shortcuts to shape belief, often without the reader noticing. We call the linguistic features exploiting such mental shortcuts cognitive bias triggers. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people encounter news, summarizing it, ranking it, and answering questions over it, a natural question is whether they can recognize the features of a text that bias a human reader. We introduce BAIT (Bias Annotation In Text), a resource for detecting cognitive bias triggers in news. BAIT pairs a schema of nine triggers, each specified in an annotator codebook, with 50 English news articles annotated by trained annotators at the article and span levels and adjudicated into a gold standard. On this data we define two tasks, detecting which triggers a text contains and locating the spans that carry them. We then benchmark six frontier LLMs zero-shot and with three or ten in-context examples. The models approach human agreement on which triggers an article contains, but rarely recover its full set of triggers, and they reach less than half of human agreement in locating the passages that carry them. Moreover, they over-predict triggers that come with easy surface cues, and most of the passages they mark for these triggers are not triggers, yet carry the trigger's surface cue far more often than random text. These findings suggest that the evaluated LLMs respond to surface cues rather than to the mechanisms that make a passage manipulative. We release the schema, the codebook, standoff annotations, and the evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 劝导性写作利用认知偏差,招募读者的心理捷径来塑造信仰,往往没有读者注意. 我们称之为语言特征 利用这种精神捷径 认知偏见触发。 由于大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地调解人们如何遇到新闻,总结新闻,排位,并在新闻上回答问题,一个自然的问题就是他们是否能够识别一个给人类读者带来偏见的文本的特征. 我们引入了BAIT(Bias Annotation in Text),这是一种用于检测新闻中认知偏差触发因素的资源. BAIT配对9个触发器的计数器,每个计数器在注释器代码簿中指定,50篇英文新闻文章由经过训练的注释器在文章中附加注释,跨度并裁定为金本位. 在这个数据上,我们定义了两项任务,即检测会触发包含文本的文本,并查找携带这些文本的跨度。 然后,我们以三个或十个内文例子作为基准,衡量六个前沿LLMs的零镜头。 模型接近人类协议 触发一个条款, 但很少恢复它的全套触发器, 并且它们达到不到人类协议的一半 此外,它们带有容易表面提示的过度预测的触发器,它们为这些触发器标记的大部分通道都不是触发器,然而比随机文本更经常携带触发器的表面提示器. 这些调查结果表明,经评估的有限责任措施是针对表面提示的,而不是使通道具有操纵作用的机制。 我们发布计划 密码本 悬案说明 以及评估程序

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cognitive biases are systematic deviations from rational reasoning that arise from the heuristic processes underlying everyday cognition ( Tversky and Kahneman 1974 ) . These heuristics help readers process information efficiently. However, they can also be exploited through persuasive writing.
blocks.zh: 认知偏差是指对理性推理的系统偏差, 这些推力学帮助读者高效地处理信息. 然而,也可以通过有说服力的写作加以利用。

blocks.en: Such writing recruits these cognitive heuristics to shape belief and form attitudes ( Petty and Cacioppo 1986 ) . Building on work on media bias and persuasion techniques in computational social science ( Spinde et al. 2021a ; Piskorski et al. 2023 ) , we refer to such persuasive writing features as cognitive bias triggers .
blocks.zh: 这种写作吸收了这些认知动力学来塑造信仰和形成态度(Petty和Cacioppo,1986年)。 在计算社会科学中的媒体偏差和说服技术(Spinde等人,2021a;Piskorski等人,2023年)的基础上,我们提到认知偏差触发等有说服力的写作特征。

blocks.en: Cognitive bias triggers are hard to annotate because they cannot be identified from wording alone. Quoting an expert, recounting one person’s story, or restating a claim are common in news writing, and each can appear in a passage that is a trigger and in one that is not. Telling the two apart depends on the rest of the article, for example whether the expert’s claim is supported by evidence anywhere in the text. Work on the creation of annotated datasets for closely related phenomena, such as propaganda ( Da San Martino et al. 2019 ) and persuasion techniques ( Piskorski et al. 2023 ) , reports the same difficulty. Both of these datasets relied on professional or expert annotators, detailed guidelines, and a consolidation step in which annotators resolved their disagreements. These datasets, however, do not record which cognitive bias a passage engages in the reader, or whether the conditions for that bias are met. To the best of our knowledge, no existing resource is annotated for this, so it is not yet possible to test whether a system can identify the passages that would bias a reader.
blocks.zh: 认知偏差的触发因素很难加以说明,因为单从措辞上无法识别。 引用一位专家,重述一个人的故事,或重述一个说法,在新闻写作中很常见,每篇都可以出现在一个作为触发的段落和一个没有的段落中. 将两者分开,取决于该条的其余部分,例如,专家的索赔在案文的任何地方是否有证据支持。 关于为密切相关的现象创建注释数据集的工作,如宣传(Da San Martino等人,2019年)和劝导技术(Piskorski等人,2023年)都报告了同样的困难. 这两套数据都依赖专业或专家的注释员、详细的准则和使注释员解决分歧的合并步骤。 然而,这些数据集没有记录某一段落涉及何种认知偏差,或该偏差的条件是否得到满足。 就我们所知,目前没有为此说明任何资源,因此尚无法测试一个系统是否能够识别会偏向读者的段落。

blocks.en: This question has become pressing as large language models (LLMs) increasingly stand between readers and the news, summarizing, retrieving, ranking, and answering questions about it. A model in this role decides what readers see and how it is framed. If it cannot recognize the passages that would bias a reader, it may pass them on unexamined or reproduce them in its own output.
blocks.zh: 这个问题变得紧迫,因为大型语言模型(LLMs)在读者与新闻之间越来越紧密地站在一起,总结,检索,排位,回答有关这个问题的问题. 这个角色中的一个模型决定读者所看到的是什么以及如何设定. 如果它不能认识到会给读者带来偏见的段落,它可能会将它们传到未经审查的段落上,或者在自己的产出中复制这些段落。

blocks.en: A growing literature establishes that LLMs are themselves subject to human-like biases in their own judgments, including anchoring, framing, and order effects ( Echterhoff et al. 2024 ; Itzhak et al. 2024 ; Koo et al. 2024 ) . That work characterizes the model as a biased reasoner. It leaves open whether a model can recognize, in text supplied to it, the features that would bias a human reader, and localize them precisely enough for the judgment to be inspected.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的文献证实,LLMs本身在自己的判断中,包括锚定、架设和秩序效应方面,都受到类似于人类的偏见(Echterhoff等人)。 2024; 伊扎克等. 2024; Koo et al. 2024 ). 这部作品将模型定性为偏颇的推理者. 它没有说明一个模型是否能够在提供给它的文本中认识到会给人类读者带来偏见的特征,并准确地将其本地化以便检查判断。

blocks.en: We introduce BAIT ( B ias A nnotation I n T ext), a resource and evaluation pipeline for detecting cognitive bias triggers in news text. Our contributions are as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍BAIT(Bias A notation I n T ext),这是一个用于检测新闻文本中认知偏差触发因素的资源和评价管道. 我们的贡献如下。

blocks.en: 1. We define a schema of nine cognitive bias triggers, each specified in an annotator codebook. Two trained annotators used it to annotate 50 English news articles at the article and span levels, and the annotations were consolidated into a gold standard. We release the schema, codebook, standoff annotations, and evaluation pipeline. 1 1 1 https://github.com/aida-ugent/BAIT 2. We define two tasks, detecting which triggers an article contains and locating the spans that carry them, and benchmark six frontier LLMs zero-shot and with three and ten in-context examples. 3. We show that models can often tell that an article contains triggers but cannot reliably point to the passages that carry them: the best model reaches a trigger-level F 1 F_{1} of 0.22, against 0.50 between two annotators. In-context examples narrow this gap without closing it. 4. We find that models respond to the surface cue of a bias rather than to its mechanism. They over-predict the triggers with the easiest cues, namely Negativity Bias (39 articles on average against 23 in the gold standard), Authority Bias (30 against 19), and Declinism (10.5 against 6). Most of the passages they mark for these triggers are not triggers, yet carry the trigger’s surface cue far more often than random text. No part of this paper has been published before.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A substantial line of work annotates bias in news and locates it in word choice. BABE ( Spinde et al. 2021a ) provides expert annotations of 3,700 news sentences, marking whether each sentence is biased and which words carry the bias, with higher inter-annotator agreement than earlier crowdsourced datasets such as MBIC ( Spinde et al. 2021b ) . MBIB ( Wessel et al. 2023 ) assembles nine media-bias tasks over twenty-two datasets, spanning linguistic, political, framing, hate-speech, and other bias types, to test how detection methods generalize across them. MBIB also includes a cognitive-bias task, which it defines as readers’ selective choice of which sources to read and trust. In practice, however, the labels come from proxies: the political leaning of an article’s outlet using the BIGNEWS dataset ( Liu et al. 2022 ) and the fact-checked truthfulness of a statement with the LIAR dataset ( Wang 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 大量的一行工作记录了新闻中的偏见,并用文字选择来定位新闻。 BABE(Spinde et al. 2021a)提供了3,700个新闻句子的专家说明,标注了每个句子是否带有偏差,以及哪些词带有偏差,与MBIC(Spinde et al. 2021b)等早期的众源数据集相比,注释者之间的协议更高. MBIB(Wessel等人,2023年)在22个数据集上组装了9个媒体-偏见任务,涉及语言、政治、框架、仇恨言论和其他偏见类型,以测试如何将侦测方法贯穿于其中。 MBIB也包含一个认知-偏见任务,它定义为读者选择哪个来源阅读和信任. 但实际上,标签来自代理:使用BIGNEWS数据集(Liu等人,2022年)对文章出口进行政治倾斜,用LIAR数据集(王2017年)对声明的真实性进行事实检查.

blocks.en: A second line annotates the rhetorical devices a text uses to persuade. Da San Martino et al. (2019) annotate news articles at fragment level with eighteen propaganda techniques and cast the problem as joint detection and localization. The SemEval-2023 Task 3 shared task ( Piskorski et al. 2023 ) extends this to twenty-three persuasion techniques across nine languages, adding genre and framing labels. Both datasets label the rhetorical devices a writer uses to persuade. Neither says which cognitive bias a passage might trigger in a reader, and a cue that relies on no named technique falls outside their label sets.
blocks.zh: 第二行对文字用来说服的修辞设备进行注释。 Da San Martino等人(2019年)用18种宣传技巧在片断层面对新闻文章进行注解,并将问题推向联合检测和本地化. 塞姆埃瓦尔-2023 任务3共享任务(Piskorski等人,2023年)将它扩展至跨越9种语言的23个说服技术,增加了流派和框架标签. 这两个数据集都给作者用来说服的修辞设备贴上标签. 也没有说哪个认知偏差 一个段落可能在读者中触发, 而一个依赖于任何命名技术的提示 不属于他们的标签集。

blocks.en: A growing body of work asks whether language models display human-like biases in their own outputs: anchoring and framing effects in decision tasks ( Echterhoff et al. 2024 ) , biases that emerge from instruction tuning ( Itzhak et al. 2024 ) , and order and egocentric effects when models act as evaluators ( Koo et al. 2024 ) . This work treats the model as a reasoner whose judgments can be distorted, and measures that distortion. A separate strand annotates reasoning defects in text directly, closest among them logical fallacy detection ( Jin et al. 2022 ) , which labels invalid argument structure as a property of the argument itself.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作询问语言模型是否在自己的产出中表现出类似于人类的偏见:决策任务的定位和框架效应(Echterhoff等人,2024年),指令调整所产生的偏见(Itzhak等人,2024年),以及当模型充当评价者时的秩序和自我中心效应(Koo等人,2024年)。 这部作品将模型视为可以扭曲其判断的理性,以及扭曲的计量. 一个单独的线条直接将文本中的推理缺陷进行注释,其中最接近逻辑谬误检测(Jin等人,2022年),将无效的论证结构标注为论证本身的属性.

blocks.en: Across these lines of work, the question of how a text might bias its reader remains open. No resource marks the passages likely to trigger a cognitive bias, or which bias each one triggers.
blocks.zh: 在这些工作领域,案文如何使读者产生偏差的问题仍未解决。 没有任何资源标记可能引发认知偏差的段落,或每个偏差触发的段落.

blocks.en: 3 The BAIT Schema
blocks.zh: 3 BAIT 司马

blocks.en:
BAIT targets cognitive biases that news text can trigger in a reader:
well-documented tendencies in human judgment that a passage can set off through
the way it presents information. We selected candidate biases from the
psychological literature on judgment, persuasion, and social cognition, and
filtered them against two criteria: • Text-surface identifiability : a trigger must produce a linguistic
signal that can be marked as a character span. This rules out biases realized only
in the reader’s prior beliefs or mental state rather than in the text. Confirmation
bias, for instance, depends on what a particular reader already believes, so no
span of text carries it on its own. • Annotation reliability : candidate biases whose surface signals
annotators could not reliably distinguish from those of another category during
calibration were removed (Section 4.2 ). The resulting schema comprises the nine trigger categories in
Table 1 .

blocks.en:
The nine categories draw on four broad mechanisms. Illusory Truth, Bandwagon
Effect, and Authority Bias concern credibility : each lends a claim weight
through something other than evidence, whether repetition, popularity, or the
standing of its source. Negativity Bias and the Identifiable Victim Effect
concern affect , steering evaluation through emotional salience.
Stereotyping concerns social categorization . Declinism, Illusory
Correlation, and Hindsight Bias concern temporal and causal reasoning :
how the past is evaluated, how events are linked, and how predictable outcomes
are made to seem. Research on misinformation documents that persuasive and
misleading writing exploits mechanisms of these kinds ( Ecker et al. 2022 ) , which makes these triggers relevant to assessing
whether language models can recognize when text is working on its reader.

blocks.en:
The nine categories sit at a single level and are non-exclusive: a single
passage may carry several triggers at once, and an article typically contains
instances of several categories. Each category is specified in an annotator
codebook giving its definition, the psychological mechanism it recruits, the
textual conditions that count as a trigger, positive and negative examples, and,
where applicable, its most likely confusion pair. Four such pairs were made explicit during
calibration: Illusory Truth and Negativity Bias (repetition versus asymmetric
weighting), Bandwagon Effect and Authority Bias (the crowd versus a specific
source), Declinism and Hindsight Bias (an evaluative versus an epistemic claim
about the past), and Illusory Correlation and Hindsight Bias (a forward causal
claim versus backward predictability). The full codebook is provided in
Appendix C . Two rules govern span annotation across all
categories: • Under the minimal-span rule , a span is the shortest contiguous
fragment that, if removed, would eliminate the trigger, so annotators mark that
fragment rather than the surrounding sentence or paragraph. • A single span may also carry more than one trigger, in which case it is
annotated once per applicable category.

blocks.en: 4.3 Annotation Protocol

blocks.en:
Both annotators labeled each article independently in two passes. The first pass
records, per category, whether the trigger occurs anywhere in the article. The
second marks the minimal span or spans carrying each present trigger, assigns its
category, and records a confidence rating on a three-point scale (1 low,
2 moderate, 3 high).

spans as copied strings, we first locate each string in the article, trying
four matchers in turn: an exact match, a case-insensitive match, a match that
tolerates differences in whitespace, and a fuzzy match that accepts a window of
the article with a character similarity of at least 0.80 to the string. When a
string occurs several times, as repeated claims often do, we prefer an
occurrence not yet used by another span of the same category in the same
output, then one that overlaps a gold span of that category, then the
leftmost. The gold standard thus only chooses between positions where the
article contains exactly the returned string, and cannot turn a wrong string
into a correct one. At least 95% of every model’s spans match exactly, and at
most 0.4% cannot be located at all (Appendix G ). A string
that cannot be located is unlocated and counts against the model at
every level below. We score localization at three levels of granularity, from
most to least forgiving, each reported as F 1 F_{1} (Equation 3 ).

blocks.en: 8 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 8 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
BAIT covers 50 English news articles from a
single source corpus, on a limited set of topics (COVID-19, climate change,
migration, and the war in Ukraine). Because the sample is random, category
frequencies follow the source corpus rather than a balanced design. Illusory
Truth occurs in 45 articles, whereas the sparsest categories rest on six or
seven, so per-bias scores for these categories are imprecise, and most
per-bias differences between models fall within noise. Pooled scores are also
dominated by the frequent categories, which is why we report per-bias results
separately. Whether the findings hold for other languages, genres, and outlets
remains to be tested.

Three directions follow directly from these
limitations. First, extending the annotation to more articles, languages and
outlets would yield enough instances of the sparse categories to compare models
on each bias reliably. Second, our results raise the question of whether the
gap between detection and localization reflects missing knowledge or missing
guidance. Giving models the full codebook, fine-tuning them on the gold
spans, or asking them to justify each trigger against the codebook’s conditions
would test whether they can learn to look past the surface cue to the
mechanism. Third, conditioning trigger detection on an explicit model of the
reader, and testing annotated triggers against reader responses in user
studies, would connect BAIT’s labels to the effects they are meant to
anticipate.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced BAIT, a resource for detecting cognitive bias triggers in news:
the features of a text that recruit a reader’s mental shortcuts to shape
belief. BAIT pairs a schema of nine triggers, each specified in an annotator
codebook, with article- and span-level annotations of 50 English news articles
adjudicated into a gold standard. Its labels describe what a passage does to a
reader, and they overlap only weakly with the persuasion techniques already
annotated on the same articles. On this data we define two tasks, detecting
which triggers an article contains and locating the spans that carry them.

Benchmarking six frontier LLMs on these tasks shows that models can tell that
an article is manipulative, but not how or where. With ten in-context
examples, detection micro-F1 reaches 0.64–0.69, close to the 0.75 that the two
annotators reach with each other, yet no model recovers an article’s full set
of biases in more than 13% of articles, against 36% for the annotators.
Localization is much weaker: the best trigger-F1 is 0.22, less than half the
trigger-F1 of 0.50 that the annotators reach with each other. In-context
examples help most for the weakest models but do not close these gaps.

The errors point to a common cause. Models over-apply the biases with the
easiest surface cues: negative vocabulary, a cited expert, a reference to the
past. Most of the spans they mark for these biases fall on text that no
annotator marked, yet these spans contain the cue two to three times as often
as random text of the same length. Current LLMs thus respond to what a trigger
looks like rather than to the conditions that make a passage one.

This matters for any system that relies on an LLM to screen, summarize, or
rank news on a reader’s behalf. Such a system would flag many manipulative
articles, but it would often misreport which mechanisms they rely on and could
not point to the passages responsible, so its judgments could not be checked
by the people they are meant to protect. We release the BAIT schema, codebook,
standoff annotations, and evaluation pipeline to support work on models that
can show, and not only state, why a text may bias its reader.

blocks.en: Appendix C Annotation Codebook
blocks.zh: 附录C 代码本

blocks.en: The codebook below defines each of the nine cognitive bias triggers. Annotators worked from these entries. Each gives the category’s definition, the cognitive mechanism it recruits, its textual trigger signals, a positive and a negative example, and notes on its boundary and on the category with which it is most readily confused. Examples are illustrative constructions used in annotator training.
blocks.zh: 下面的代码手册定义了九个认知偏差触发器中的每一个. 注释员从这些条目工作。 每一个都给出了该类的定义、它所引入的认知机制、其文字触发信号、一个正面和负面的例子,以及它最容易被混淆的边界和类别的说明。 说明员培训中所用的说明性说明就是例子。

blocks.en: B01 Illusory Truth
blocks.zh: B01 虚幻的真相

blocks.en: Definition. A claim is repeated two or more times within the article, verbatim or in varied wording, such that repetition alone increases its perceived truth value independent of evidential support. Mechanism. Processing fluency. Text encountered before is processed more easily, and that ease is misattributed as evidence of truth. Trigger signals. Verbatim or near-verbatim repetition of a claim across paragraphs; reformulated repetition of the same proposition; anaphoric cues such as “as noted earlier” or “to repeat”; echoing of the same claim across title, opening, and closing. Positive example. “The new tax will devastate small businesses. Local entrepreneurs warn that the policy will devastate small businesses across the country. As mentioned, this measure threatens to destroy small business in our communities.” Negative example. “The new tax will affect small businesses. According to a 2024 industry survey, 62% of business owners expect reduced margins, and 18% anticipate closures within two years.” Boundary and confusion. Topical recurrence is not illusory truth. The trigger requires the same propositional content to be asserted repeatedly, not merely the same subject discussed from different angles. Most readily confused with B02. B01 concerns repetition of any claim regardless of valence, whereas B02 concerns asymmetric negative weighting.
blocks.zh: 定义。 一项主张在文章中重复了两次或多次,既逐字重复,又措辞不一,因此,仅重复一次就增加了它所认为的真实价值,而不受证据支持的影响。 机制。 处理流利。 以前遇到的文字更容易处理,这种容易被误认为是真理的证据。 触发信号。 逐段重复或几乎逐段重复索赔;重新重复同一主张;发出诸如“如前所述”或“重复”的反响;在标题、开头和结尾处重复同一主张。 积极的例子。 “新税将破坏小企业。 当地企业家警告称,该政策将破坏全国的小企业. 如上所述,这一措施有可能破坏我们社区的小企业。” 负例. “新税将影响到小企业。 根据2024年的一项工业调查,62%的企业业主预计利润会减少,18%预计在两年内关闭。” 疆界与迷惑. 专题重复不是虚幻的真理。 触发因素要求反复申明相同的命题内容,而不仅仅是从不同角度讨论的同一主题。 最容易与B02混淆. B01涉及无论价值如何重复任何索赔,而B02则涉及不对称负加权。

blocks.en: B02 Negativity Bias
blocks.zh: B02 隐性比喻

blocks.en: Definition. Negative information (harm, threat, loss, failure) is foregrounded, elaborated, or weighted more heavily than positive or neutral information of comparable magnitude, biasing the reader’s overall evaluation. Mechanism. Negative valence captures attention disproportionately and is encoded with greater perceptual and semantic detail than positive valence of equal objective magnitude. Trigger signals. Headline or lead foregrounding harm, loss, or threat; asymmetric elaboration of negative outcomes with comparable positives omitted or minimized; catastrophizing vocabulary (“crisis”, “disaster”, “collapse”, “devastating”); loss-framed numerical reporting where gain framing was equally available. Positive example. “The economy shed 200,000 jobs last month in what experts called a catastrophic collapse. Meanwhile, a modest 30,000 new positions were added in tech.” Negative example. “The labor market lost 200,000 jobs in declining sectors and added 30,000 in expanding ones, a net contraction of 170,000 positions.” Boundary and confusion. Reporting on a genuinely negative event is not in itself a trigger. The trigger requires asymmetric elaboration or catastrophizing relative to what the facts support. Distinguished from B01 by asymmetric weighting rather than repetition.
blocks.zh: 定义。 负面信息(伤害、威胁、损失、失败)比相当规模的正面或中性信息更有预见、更详细或更加权,对读者的总体评价产生偏见。 机制。 负值值吸引了过多的注意力,其编码的知觉和语义细节比等量客观的正值值要多. 触发信号。 标题或铅预示损害、损失或威胁; 不对称地阐述具有可比正数的负面结果,省略或尽量减少; 灾难性词汇(“危机”、“灾害”、“崩溃”、“退缩”); 损失范围的数字报告,在收益框架相同的情况下。 积极的例子。 “上个月,经济在专家所称的灾难性崩溃中损失了20万个工作。 与此同时,在技术方面增加了30 000个小职位。” 负例. “劳动力市场在衰退部门失去了20万个就业机会,在扩张部门又增加了30 000个就业机会,净收缩了170 000个职位。” 疆界与迷惑. 报告真正消极的事件本身并不是触发因素。 触发器需要非对称的细化或与事实所支持的相对的萎缩. 与B01区分的是不对称的权重而不是重复.

blocks.en: B03 Bandwagon Effect
blocks.zh: B03 班德瓦贡效应

blocks.en: Definition. Claims are presented as believed or endorsed by a large or growing majority, triggering the tendency to align one’s own belief with perceived social consensus. Mechanism. Social proof. Majority adoption is treated as evidence of correctness, independent of the underlying argument. Trigger signals. Explicit majority appeal (“most people”, “everyone knows”, “millions have already…”); viral or trending language; polling data framed to emphasize consensus without methodological qualification; late-adoption shame framing (“you haven’t heard about this yet?”). Positive example. “Millions of parents have already switched to the new formula. Are you still using the old one?” Negative example. “A survey of 1,000 parents found that 60% preferred the new formula, though the authors note the sample was not nationally representative.” Boundary and confusion. Citing polling data is not itself a trigger. The data must be framed to create social pressure or imply that deviating from the majority is unreasonable. Most readily confused with B04. B03 invokes the crowd and B04 a specific authority, and the two may co-occur in a single span.
blocks.zh: 定义。 索赔是以多数或越来越多的多数所相信或赞同的方式提出的,这引发了将个人的信念与所认为的社会共识挂钩的趋势。 机制。 社会证明. 多数收养被视为正确性的证据,与基本论点无关。 触发信号。 明确多数人上诉(“大多数人”、“人人都知道”、“百万人已经......”); 病毒性或趋势性语言; 投票数据旨在强调协商一致而不附带方法限制; 过时采用的耻辱框架(“你还没有听说过吗? ” )。 积极的例子。 “数百万父母已经转向新的方案。 你还在用旧的吗?” 负例. “对1 000名父母的调查发现,60%的人倾向于采用新的公式,尽管作者指出,样本没有全国代表性。” 疆界与迷惑. 引用投票数据本身并不是触发因素。 数据必须用来制造社会压力或暗示背离多数是不合理的。 最容易与B04混淆. B03援引人群和B04的特定权威,两者可能在单一的时间内共同占卜.

blocks.en: B04 Authority Bias
blocks.zh: B04 当局

blocks.en: Definition. A claim is endorsed by or attributed to an authority figure or institution in a way that substitutes for, rather than accompanies, evidential support. Mechanism. Source expertise, real or claimed, is used as a peripheral cue to accept the message without scrutinizing its content. Trigger signals. Expert endorsement without cited evidence; credential inflation (“leading scientist”, “world-renowned expert”); institutional authority invoked to close debate (“the science is settled”); irrelevant or off-domain authority presented with impressive credentials. Positive example. “Dr Helena Marsh, a leading nutrition expert, warns that the chemical changes in the new formula are ‘potentially devastating’ for children.” Negative example. “Dr Helena Marsh, who led the 2023 longitudinal study published in The Lancet, reports that the modified compound was associated with a 12% increase in adverse outcomes ( n = 4,200 n=4{,}200 , p < 0.01 p<0.01 ).” Boundary and confusion. Quoting an expert is not itself a trigger. The credential must substitute for the evidential basis the claim would otherwise need. Distinguished from B03 by invoking a specific authority rather than the crowd.
blocks.zh: 定义。 索赔由一个权威人物或机构以取代而不是附带证据支持的方式予以认可或归属。 机制。 原始专门知识,无论是真实的还是声称的,都被用作在不仔细检查信息内容的情况下接受信息的外围提示。 触发信号。 专家认可,但未援引证据; 证明通货膨胀(“领导科学家”、“世界知名专家”); 援引机构权威来结束辩论(“科学已解决”); 无关或领域外权威,具有令人印象深刻的资质。 积极的例子。 “主要营养专家Helena Marsh博士警告说,新配方的化学变化对儿童来说是“潜在毁灭性的”。 负例. “Helena Marsh博士领导了《柳叶刀》出版的2023年纵向研究,他报告说,经过改造的化合物与12%的不良结果(n=4 200 n=4{,}200,p < 0.01 p < 0.01)有关。” 引用专家本身不是触发因素. 证书必须取代索赔本来需要的证据基础。 与B03区别在于引用特定权威而不是人群.

blocks.en: B05 Stereotyping
blocks.zh: B05 陈规定型观念

blocks.en: Definition. A group is described as having fixed traits, dispositions, or characteristics, with individual members presumed to share them by virtue of group membership. Mechanism. Prototype matching. A group label activates a fixed set of attributed characteristics, and individual variation is suppressed. Trigger signals. Generic group statements (“Women are…”, “Immigrants tend to…”); essentialist framing (“it’s in their nature”, “cultural DNA”); statistical generalization applied at the individual level without hedging; traits attributed to group membership rather than to circumstance or structure. Positive example. “These migrants don’t value education — it’s a cultural thing. That’s why their children underperform.” Negative example. “Children from low-income households, regardless of national or cultural background, face documented systemic barriers in education, including under-resourced schools and reduced access to early-years support.” Boundary and confusion. Properly hedged statistical claims (“on average”, “in this sample”) are not stereotyping. The trigger is unqualified generalization or attribution of outcomes to group essence rather than to structural conditions.
blocks.zh: 定义。 团体被描述为具有固定的特征、处置方式或特征,根据团体成员资格推定个别成员分享这些特征。 机制。 原型匹配. 一组标签激活一组固定的归属特性,个体变异被抑制. 触发信号。 一般群体声明( " 妇女是. " , " 移民倾向于. " );基本主义框架( " 其性质是.的 " , " 文化DNA " );在个人一级适用的统计统称,没有套期保值;特征归因于群体成员,而不是情况或结构。 积极的例子。 “这些移民不重视教育, 因此他们的孩子表现不佳。 负例. “低收入家庭的儿童,无论民族或文化背景如何,在教育方面都面临有记录的系统性障碍,包括资源不足的学校以及获得幼儿支助的机会减少。” 疆界与迷惑. 适当的套期统计债权(“平均”,“在本样本中”)不是定型观念。 触发因素是将结果无条件概括或归属于群体实质,而不是结构条件。

blocks.en: B06 Declinism
blocks.zh: B06 衰落主义

blocks.en: Definition. The past is systematically presented as superior to the present, framing current conditions as degraded, lost, or corrupted relative to an idealized prior state. Mechanism. The idealized past serves as an anchor, and the present is evaluated against a selectively reconstructed, rosier baseline. Trigger signals. Explicit nostalgia framing (“things were better when…”); asymmetric comparison in which past virtues are detailed and past problems ignored; “golden age” language; restoration rhetoric (“return to”, “reclaim what was lost”). Positive example. “There was a time when this country worked. People had real jobs, real communities, real values. Today we have nothing of the kind — only decay where there was once dignity.” Negative example. “Manufacturing employment in the region fell from 38% in 1970 to 11% in 2023, while service-sector employment rose from 41% to 67% over the same period.” Boundary and confusion. Acknowledging that something has worsened is not itself declinism. The trigger requires the present to be framed as degraded against an idealized past whose own problems are selectively omitted. Most readily confused with B09. Declinism is an evaluative comparison (the past was better), whereas hindsight is epistemic certainty (the outcome was predictable).
blocks.zh: 定义。 将过去系统地描述为优于现在,将当前状况描述为相对于理想化的先前状态的退化、丧失或腐败。 机制。 理想化的过去充当了锚,而现在则根据有选择地重建的、更加罗素的基线来评估。 触发信号。 明确的怀旧框架(“......时事情更好”);不对称的比较,其中过去美德是详细的,过去的问题是被忽视的;“黄金时代”语言;恢复言论(“回归”,“收回失去的东西”)。 积极的例子。 “有一段时间,这个国家曾经工作。 人们有真正的工作, 真正的社区,真正的价值。 今天,我们没有这种东西——只有曾经有尊严的地方才衰落。” 负例. “该地区的制造业就业率从1970年的38%下降到2023年的11%,而服务业就业率同期从41%上升到67%。” 疆界与迷惑. 承认有些事情已经恶化,这本身并不是冷漠主义。 触发因素要求把现在描述为退化的过去,有选择地忽略了过去的理想。 最容易与B09混淆. 下降主义是一种评价性比较(过去比较好),而后发现则是认知性的确定性(结果可以预测)。

blocks.en: B07 Identifiable Victim Effect
blocks.zh: B07 可识别 受害者影响

blocks.en: Definition. A single, named, humanized victim produces a far stronger emotional response and call to action than statistical descriptions of equal or greater harm affecting anonymous populations. Mechanism. Concrete, specific individuals activate empathy more powerfully than statistical abstraction, so the identified life is weighted disproportionately to the statistical one. Trigger signals. A named victim with biographical detail (name, age, family, backstory); first-person or direct-speech testimony of suffering; explicit contrast between the individual and a statistic (“this is not a number, this is Sarah”); emotional focus on one person while aggregate data is absent or minimized. Positive example. “Seven-year-old Emma loved football and drawing. Last Tuesday, she died from a preventable disease. How many more Emmas must we lose?” Negative example. “The disease kills approximately 4,000 children annually in this region. Emma’s case, reported last week, reflects a pattern documented across 23 countries.” Boundary and confusion. A personal story presented alongside statistical context does not trigger the bias. The trigger is disproportionate or exclusive use of the individual case to motivate a claim, with aggregate evidence suppressed or absent.
blocks.zh: 定义。 与统计上对影响匿名人口的同等或更大的伤害的描述相比,单一的、被命名为人性的受害人产生更强烈的情绪反应和行动呼吁。 机制。 具体、具体的个人比统计抽象更能激发同情,因此,被确定的生命比统计生命更重。 触发信号。 具有传记细节(姓名、年龄、家庭、背景);第一人称或直接陈述痛苦的证词;个人与统计数据之间的明显对比(“这不是一个数字,而是Sarah”);在缺乏或尽量减少汇总数据的情况下,对一人的情感关注。 积极的例子。 “七岁的艾玛喜欢足球和绘画。 上星期二,她死于可预防的疾病。 我们还得失去多少艾玛?” 负例. “这一疾病每年在该区域造成大约4 000名儿童死亡。 上星期报道的艾玛案反映了23个国家记录的格局。 疆界与迷惑. 与统计背景一起介绍的个人故事不会引发偏见。 触发因素不相称地或专门利用个别案件来推动索赔,同时压制或缺乏综合证据。

blocks.en: B08 Illusory Correlation
blocks.zh: B08 错觉关联

blocks.en: Definition. A text presents two events or variables as causally or correlatively linked when the co-occurrence is coincidental, selective, or logically insufficient to establish the claimed relationship. Mechanism. Pattern detection overgeneralizes. Distinctive co-occurrences are weighted more heavily than their joint frequency warrants, and temporal sequence is mistaken for causal mechanism. Trigger signals. Post hoc reasoning (“after X, Y occurred, which is why…”); juxtaposition of events with no stated mechanism; selective reporting of only the co-occurring cases; correlation presented as causation without mechanism, controls, or counterfactual. Positive example. “The day after the new mayor took office, crime rose by 5%. His policies are already making the city less safe.” Negative example. “Crime statistics for the month following the new mayor’s inauguration showed a 5% increase. Criminologists note that month-to-month fluctuations of this magnitude are typical and cannot be attributed to policies implemented only days earlier.” Boundary and confusion. Not every temporal sequence is a trigger. The text must present the sequence as evidence of a causal or systematic relationship without sufficient justification. Most readily confused with B09. B08 is a forward causal claim (cause → \rightarrow effect), B09 a backward claim of prior predictability (outcome → \rightarrow “should have known”).
blocks.zh: 定义。 案文提出两个事件或变量,作为因果或相对关联的,当共同发生的是偶然的、选择性的或逻辑上不足以确定所主张的关系时。 机制。 模式检测过度概括。 不同的共发性比其联合频率令的加权更重,时间序列被误认为是因果机制. 触发信号。 事后的推理(“在X, Y之后发生,这就是为什么......”); 将没有规定机制的事件并列; 选择性地只报告共同发生的案件; 将关联作为因果关系提出,没有机制、控制或反事实。 积极的例子。 “新市长上任的第二天,犯罪率上升了5%。 他的政策已经使城市更加不安全。” 负例. “新市长就职后一个月的犯罪统计数字显示增加了5%。 犯罪学家指出,这种规模的每月波动是典型的,不能归咎于仅仅几天前实施的政策。” 疆界与迷惑. 不是每个时间序列都是触发器 案文必须在没有充分理由的情况下将序列作为因果关系或系统关系的证据。 最容易与B09混淆. B08是先期的因果索赔(因为 ) , B09是先期可预期性的后期索赔(结果 ) , “ 应该知道” 。

blocks.en: B09 Hindsight Bias
blocks.zh: B09 光明比亚斯

blocks.en: Definition. Knowing the outcome of an event, a text presents that outcome as having been obvious or predictable beforehand, understating the genuine uncertainty that existed at the time. Mechanism. Outcome knowledge is projected backwards onto the prior state, inflating perceived ex-ante predictability and erasing genuine epistemic uncertainty. Trigger signals. Phrases asserting prior obviousness (“it was always clear that…”, “anyone could have seen this coming”, “it was inevitable”); retrospective certainty reconstructing events as foreordained; blame framing dependent on post-hoc predictability (“they should have known”); selective citation of early warnings while ignoring contemporary uncertainty. Positive example. “It was obvious from the beginning that the policy would fail. The warning signs were all there, and anyone paying attention could have predicted this outcome.” Negative example. “Analysts were divided at the time of the policy’s launch. Some predicted success, citing X, and others warned of failure, citing Y. In retrospect, the critics’ concerns proved well-founded.” Boundary and confusion. Legitimate retrospective analysis that acknowledges prior uncertainty is not hindsight bias. The trigger requires the outcome to be presented as having been obviously predictable, erasing the genuine ex-ante epistemic state. Distinguished from B06 by concerning certainty about a specific outcome rather than idealization of an era.
blocks.zh: 定义。 一项案文了解某一事件的结果,认为该结果事先是显而易见或可预测的,低估了当时存在的真正的不确定性。 机制。 结果知识被推向先前状态,夸大了预感的可预测性,并消除了真正的认知不确定性。 触发信号。 声称事前明显性的措辞(“始终很清楚......”)、“任何人都可以预见到这种情况的到来”,“这是不可避免的”;追溯性确定性重建事件,这是预先注定的;责任的设定取决于事后的可预测性(“它们应该知道”);选择性地引用预警,同时忽略当代的不确定性。 积极的例子。 “政策从一开始就显然会失败。 警告迹象都存在,任何注意的人都有可能预见到这一结果。” 负例. " 在政策出台时,分析是分开的。 一些人以X为例预言成功,其他人以Y为例警告失败. 回想起来,批评者的关切证明是有根据的。 疆界与迷惑. 承认先前的不确定性的合法的追溯分析并不是事后偏差。 触发因素要求将结果表述为显然可以预测的,从而消除了真正的先兆状态。 与B06不同的是,它涉及一个具体结果的确定性,而不是一个时代的理想化。

blocks.en: All settings share one system prompt (Figure 6 ). It describes the two tasks, gives a one-line definition of each bias, states the rule for multi-span triggers, and fixes the output format. The user message (Figure 7 ) contains the target article. With k > 0 k>0 , the target article is preceded by k k annotated example articles, which are part of the user message rather than separate dialogue turns. The examples are drawn separately for each target article from the other 49 articles, so that no article ever appears among its own examples, with a random generator seeded by the run seed (17, 23 or 29) and the target article. The draw is not fully uniform. One of the k k examples is always drawn from the articles that contain a multi-span trigger, so that every few-shot prompt demonstrates the grouping convention, and the remaining k − 1 k-1 are drawn uniformly from the rest. The order of the examples is then shuffled. Each example consists of the full article text followed by its gold annotation in the required output format. In the examples, the rationale field is filled with a fixed sentence (“These span(s) jointly trigger B01 Illusory Truth.”), so the examples show which spans form a trigger but not why. An example article without triggers is shown with biases_present set to ["NONE"] and an empty trigger list.

Some of the boundary conditions in the codebook appear in these definitions in compressed form, for instance “disproportionate weight” for Negativity Bias and “beyond what the evidence supports” for Authority Bias. Others do not. The definition of Declinism, for instance, does not say that the idealized past must omit its own problems. The prompt also asks that each span belong to exactly one trigger, whereas the gold standard lets one passage carry triggers of two biases (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 这些模型收到了图6中的单行定义,而不是附录C的注释码本。 编码本中的一些边界条件以压缩的形式出现在这些定义中,例如,Negatitual Bias的“份量过大”,而权威Bias的“超出证据支持的范围”。 其他人没有。 例如,衰落主义的定义并不表示理想化的过去必须省略其自身的问题。 提示器还要求每个跨度都属于一个触发点,而金本位则允许一个通过点带有两个偏差的触发点(附录D)。

blocks.en: Document-level detection : identify which cognitive biases from the taxonomy below are triggered anywhere in the article.
blocks.zh: 文件级检测 : 确定以下分类中哪些认知偏差在文章的任何地方触发.

blocks.en: Trigger extraction : for each bias you detect, extract the triggers — the specific text that would activate that bias in a reader. A trigger is a unit of persuasive effect, and it may consist of ONE span or SEVERAL related spans that jointly produce the effect.
blocks.zh: 触发提取 : 对于您发现的每一个偏差, 提取触发器 —— 在读取器中激活该偏差的具体文本 。 触发是具有说服力的单位,它可能包括一个跨或SEVERAL相关跨,共同产生效果.

blocks.en: B01 Illusory Truth — a claim gains credibility through repetition. The trigger is the set of repetitions : the same claim or near-paraphrase stated at multiple points in the article.
blocks.zh: B01 Illusory Truth——一项主张通过重复获得了可信度. 触发器是重复的一组 : 在文章的多个点上声明的同一要求或近似参数.

blocks.en: B02 Negativity Bias — disproportionate weight given to negative framing, threats, losses, or alarming language.
blocks.zh: B02 疏忽 偏见——过分重视负面框架、威胁、损失或令人震惊的语言。

blocks.en: B03 Bandwagon Effect — appeal to popularity or consensus (“everyone knows”, “growing numbers agree”) as grounds for belief.
blocks.zh: B03 宽角 效果——呼吁人们接受欢迎或达成共识(“人人都知道”,“越来越多的人同意”)作为信仰的理由。

blocks.en: B04 Authority Bias — reliance on an authority figure, title, or institution as the warrant for a claim, beyond what the evidence supports.
blocks.zh: B04 权威 Bias——除了证据所证明的以外,以当局人物、所有权或机构作为索赔的逮捕证。

blocks.en: B05 Stereotyping — attributing traits to individuals based on group membership.
blocks.zh: B05 定型——将特质赋予基于团体成员资格的个人.

blocks.en: B06 Declinism — framing the present or future as decay from a better past.
blocks.zh: B06 衰落主义——将现在或未来设定为从更好的过去衰落.

blocks.en: B07 Identifiable Victim Effect — a single named or vividly described individual stands in for a broader issue, driving emotional response.
blocks.zh: B07 可识别 受害者效应——一个被点名或生动描述的个人代表一个更广泛的问题,推动情绪反应。

blocks.en: B08 Illusory Correlation — implying a causal or meaningful link between co-occurring events or traits without support.
blocks.zh: B08 Illusory Correlation——指在没有支持的情况下共同发生的事件或特征之间的因果关系或有意义的联系.

blocks.en: B09 Hindsight Bias — presenting past events as having been predictable or inevitable (“it was obvious this would happen”).
blocks.zh: B09 光辉 Bias——将过去的事件说成是可预见或不可避免的(显然会发生这种情况)。

blocks.en: Every span MUST be a verbatim, character-exact substring of the article text. Do not paraphrase, normalize whitespace, or fix typos.
blocks.zh: 每个跨度都是文章文本的逐字记录性字符精确子字符串。 不要解释, 正常的白空间, 或修正类型 。

blocks.en: Keep spans minimal: the shortest stretch of text that carries the trigger, typically a clause or sentence, not a whole paragraph.
blocks.zh: 保持最小的长度:带触发器的文本最短的长度,一般是条款或句子,而不是整个段落.

blocks.en: biases_present must exactly equal the set of biases appearing in triggers . If no bias is triggered, return {"biases_present": ["NONE"], "triggers": []} .
blocks.zh: 偏见必须完全等同于触发因素中出现的偏见。 如果没有触发偏差,请返回 {'biases_present' : ["NONE"],"触发": []].

blocks.en: Number triggers T1, T2, … in order of first appearance in the article.
blocks.zh: 数字触发T1,T2... 依次为文章中的首次出现.

blocks.en: A span belongs to exactly one trigger.
blocks.zh: 一个跨度完全属于一个触发器。

blocks.en: Appendix G Span Alignment
blocks.zh: 附录G 对齐

blocks.en: Models return each span as a string copied from the article rather than as character offsets. Before scoring, we align every predicted string to the source text with a cascade of four matchers, stopping at the first that succeeds. 1. Exact. The string occurs verbatim in the article, as returned or after stripping leading and trailing whitespace. 2. Case-normalized. The string occurs in the article after lower-casing both. This recovers spans where the model changed the capitalization of the first word. 3. Whitespace-flexible. The words of the string occur in the article in the same order, separated by any whitespace (first case-sensitive, then case-insensitive). This recovers spans where the model replaced a line break in the article with a space. 4. Fuzzy. We find the longest block of characters that the string shares with the article, which must cover at least 10 characters and at least half the string. We then take the window of the article that has the string’s length and lines up with that block, and accept it if its difflib similarity ratio with the string is at least 0.80. A string that none of the matchers can place is marked as unlocated. Unlocated spans are never discarded. At the character level they contribute their full length as false positives, at the span level they count as false positive spans, and at the trigger level their length is added to the size of the predicted trigger (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 模型以文章复制的字符串而不是字符抵消的方式返回每个跨度。 在评分前,我们将每个预言的字符串与源文本对齐,与四个匹配者的级联对齐,在第一个成功时停止. 1. 准确无误。 字符串在文章中逐字发生, 如返回或剥离后引导和跟踪白空间。 2. 个案正常化。 字符串发生在文章中,先是下划线,然后是两者。 这在模型改变第一个单词资本化的地方是恢复期。 3. 白空间灵活。 字符串的词在文章中以相同的顺序出现,由任意的白空间(第一大小写敏感,然后小写敏感)分隔. 这个恢复的跨度是模型将文章中的换行符替换为空格. 4. 模糊。 我们发现字符串与文章共享的最长字符块,它必须覆盖至少10个字符和至少一半的字符串. 然后,我们取有字符串长度和线条与该块的窗口,如果其与字符串的difflib相似率至少为0.80,则接受该窗口。 没有一个匹配者可以放置的字符串被标记为未定位 。 未定位的跨度永远不会被丢弃. 在字符级别上,它们作为假阳性贡献其全长,在跨度级别上,它们算作假阳性跨度,在触发级别上,它们的长度被添加到预测触发器的大小上(第5节).

blocks.en: Fuzzy. We find the longest block of characters that the string shares with the article, which must cover at least 10 characters and at least half the string. We then take the window of the article that has the string’s length and lines up with that block, and accept it if its difflib similarity ratio with the string is at least 0.80.
blocks.zh: 佛齐. 我们发现字符串与文章共享的最长字符块,它必须覆盖至少10个字符和至少一半的字符串. 然后,我们取有字符串长度和线条与该块的窗口,如果其与字符串的difflib相似率至少为0.80,则接受该窗口。

blocks.en: A string can match the article in several places, which is common for Illusory Truth, where an identical claim recurs. The candidate positions are then ranked by three criteria in turn. A position not yet taken by an earlier span of the same bias in the same output comes first, so that repeated mentions are spread over their occurrences. Next comes a position that overlaps a gold span of the same bias, and last the leftmost position. The second criterion uses the gold standard, but only to choose between positions where the article contains exactly the string the model returned. It cannot turn a wrong string into a correct one, and without it the score would reflect the aligner’s arbitrary choice of occurrence rather than the model’s output. Copying the gold spans as predictions scores a character-level F 1 F_{1} of 1.0.
blocks.zh: 一个字符串可以在几个地方与文章相匹配,这在Illusory Truth中是常见的,其中同一说法重复出现. 然后按三个标准对候选人职位进行排名。 同一产出中同一偏差的较早阶段尚未采取的立场首先出现,因此,重复提及的情况会分散在它们发生的地方。 下一个位置与同一偏差的黄金间距重叠,最后是最左边的位置。 第二种标准采用金本位,但只用于在文章中确切包含模型返回的字符串的位置之间作出选择. 它不能把错误的字符串变成正确的字符串,没有它,得分将反映对齐者任意选择的发生,而不是模型的输出. 复制黄金间距作为预测分数,字符级F 1 FQQQ1}为1.0.

blocks.en: Alignment is close to lossless. Every model copies at least 95% of its spans verbatim, and at most 0.40% of any model’s spans, or 0.29% of its predicted characters, cannot be located. DeepSeek-V4 and Mistral Medium 3.5 rely most on the later matching steps, which resolve 3.0% and 4.5% of their spans respectively.
blocks.zh: 对齐接近无损. 每个模型至少复制95%的跨度,任何一个模型最多复制0.40%的跨度,即预测字符的0.29%,都无法找到。 DeepSeek-V4和Mistral Medium 3.5主要依赖后期的匹配步骤,它们分别解决了各自跨度的3.0%和4.5%.

blocks.en: Fuzzy matches mostly repair small copying errors, such as a changed verb tense or a dropped article. The median similarity between the model’s string and the aligned text is 0.98. A small number of fuzzy matches attach a string that does not occur in the article to a similar passage, for instance a quotation in which the model altered a time expression but kept the rest of the sentence. Of the 213 fuzzy matches, 21 have a similarity below 0.90 to the text they are aligned to. These make up about 0.1% of all predicted spans.
blocks.zh: 模糊的匹配大多是修复小的复制错误,例如修改动词时态或丢弃的文章. 模型的字符串与对齐文本的中位相似度为0.98. 少数模糊的匹配将文章中不出现的字符串附加到类似的段落中,例如引文中,模型改变了时间表达,但保留了句子的其余部分. 在213个模糊的火柴中,21个与它们对应的文本的相似度低于0.90. 这些占所有预测跨度的约0.1%。

blocks.en: Table 8 gives the standard deviation of each corpus-level score over the three runs per setting. For k = 3 k=3 and k = 10 k=10 this is the variation over the three example draws. Zero-shot prompts contain no examples, but each of the three runs re-queried the models, so the zero-shot standard deviation measures run-to-run nondeterminism. This nondeterminism is substantial at the level of individual outputs. Across the three zero-shot runs, a model returned exactly the same triggers for between 1 (Claude Opus 4.8, Grok 4.5) and 9 (GPT-5.6) of the 50 articles, and exactly the same set of biases for between 6 (Kimi K3) and 35 (DeepSeek-V4). At the corpus level it largely averages out. All standard deviations are at most 0.042, and at most 0.024 for the Task 2 scores, which is small compared with the gains from ten examples for every model except Mistral Medium 3.5, whose gains are not significant (Figures 2 and 3 ). Because of this nondeterminism, Table 4 and Figures 2 and 3 average the zero-shot condition over all six zero-shot runs, one accompanying each few-shot run. The standard deviations in Table 8 are computed over the three zero-shot runs that accompany the k = 10 k=10 draws.
blocks.zh: 表8列出了每场比赛三次中每个实体等级分的标准差。 对于 k = 3 k = 3 和 k = 10 k = 10 这是三个示例图中的变数. 0射速提示没有实例,但3个运行中每个运行重排了模型,因此0射速标准偏差度量了运行到运行的非定数. 这种非决定性在个别产出一级是重大的。 在3次零射程中,一个型号在50篇文章的1(Claude Opus 4.8,Grok 4.5)至9(GPT-5.6)之间返回了完全相同的触发器,在6(Kimi K3)至35(Deep Seek-V4)之间返回了完全相同的一组偏差. 在体格层面,大致上是平均的。 所有标准偏差最多为0.042,任务2的分数最多为0.024,与除Mistral Medium 3.5外的每个模型的十个实例的得分相比,这个得分很小,因为Mistral Medium的得分并不显著(图2和图3). 由于这种非定型,表4和图2和图3在所有6个零射线跑中平均为零射线条件,每几个射线跑中一个随行. 表8中的标准差是按K=10 k=10图画的3个零射线计算出来的。

blocks.en: Trigger-F1 is the only metric that evaluates grouping (Section 5 ). Table 9 describes how the models group spans into triggers. In the gold standard, grouping is almost entirely a property of Illusory Truth. 97% of B01 triggers consist of several mentions of one claim, whereas only 1 of the 251 triggers of the other eight biases spans more than one passage.
blocks.zh: Triggger-F1是评价分组的唯一衡量标准(第5节). 表9说明了模型组如何跨入触发器。 在金本位中,组合几乎完全是Illusory Truth的财产. 97%的B01触发器包含数个提及一个主张,而其他8个偏差的251个触发器中只有1个跨越一个以上的段落.

blocks.en: Zero-shot, the models over-group. All of them group B01 mentions, as the definition asks, but they also merge passages of other biases into multi-span triggers, from 25% of non-B01 triggers for Mistral Medium 3.5 to 80% for DeepSeek-V4. They return fewer triggers than the gold standard (3.1 to 6.1 per article against 8.0) and pack more mentions into each B01 trigger (2.8 to 3.7 against 2.3). Examples largely correct this. At k = 10 k=10 , the share of multi-span triggers outside B01 falls to between 1% and 11% for five of the six models, and the number of triggers per article rises to between 6.0 and 11.3, around the gold value. Claude Opus 4.8 changes least and still groups 23% of its non-B01 triggers. This change in grouping coincides with the trigger-F1 gains from examples (Figure 3 ), which suggests that the examples convey BAIT’s grouping convention. Span length, by contrast, already matches the gold standard zero-shot. Predicted spans average 14 to 18 words against 17 for gold spans, in both settings.
blocks.zh: 零拍,型号超群. 正如定义所要求,他们都提到过B01组,但他们也将其他偏差的段落合并成多斯潘触发器,从Mistral Medium的25%的非B01触发器到DeepSeek-V4的80%. 它们返回的触发器少于金本位(每条3.1至6.1对8.0),并将更多的提及器装入每个B01触发器(2.8至3.7对2.3)。 例子基本上纠正了这一点。 在k = 10 k = 10时,B01以外的多斯潘触发器的比重在6种型号的5种中下降到1%至11%之间,每件物品的触发器数量在黄金值左右上升到6.0至11.3之间. Claude Opus 4.8 变化最小,仍将其非B01触发器的23%分组. 分组的这一变化与实例的触发-F1收益相吻合(图3),这表明实例传达了BAIT的分组公约。 相比之下,Span长度已经符合金本位零射线. 在两种情况下,黄金平均为14至18字,黄金为17字。
